    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    def nzc(seq): return sum(1 for x in seq if x!=0)
    hrows=[r for r in range(H) if nzc(inp[r])==W]

    out=[[0]*Ow for _ in range(Oh)]
    for i,h in enumerate(hc):
        for j in range(Ow): out[2*i+1][j]=h
    for j,v in enumerate(vc):
        for i in range(Oh): out[i][2*j+1]=v
